description: Customize your life. It was created specifically for you 🪴#LifeByDesign #IntentionalLiving #designyourlife
transcript: Our lives are meant to be customized. Our lives have been personalized specifically for us. Accountability leads us to customizing it the way that we want. The external world begins to align with it. We are not at war with the external world. Our internal world is here to work in alignment with the external world. Reality is that this world is so big, and it's created in order for us to live a full life. And we live full lives when we take action and customize it the way that we want it to be.
